title: When Fancy Eviction Fails: Rethinking Cache Replacement For LLM Prefix Reuse
summary: Long-running LLM applications repeatedly send growing context, making prefix caching critical for reducing prefill cost. Yet prefix-cache behavior under agentic workloads remains poorly understood. We study production traces from two companies and evaluate 14 eviction algorithms across HBM-constrained and large memory-pool settings.
